There are currently 8 realms

Aequor, Benthos Aequor (generally called BAequor) Chaos, Primordial Chaos (PChaos), Caro, Propagation Caro (PCaro), Ultra and Singularity Ultra (SUltra). The second version of each base realm used to just be called "Divine [Base Realm Name]".
